messages.text: Browser-side checks for AC-dm-33 and AC-dm-34 are not run by this unit and need the frontend lane plus Playwright. Steps: (1) add the Playwright config and tests/e2e/home.spec.ts; (2) run `pnpm test:e2e` from the workspace root; (3) for AC-dm-33 change a diagnosis (conclude, archive, restore) and confirm the home indicators change on the next open; (4) for AC-dm-34 in consultoria mode tap each stage step and confirm the filtered list opens, and confirm the stale-draft (>7 days), overdue (>90 days) and high-risk lists link to the right companies. Save the exit code and log under the run's execution-temp directory.

Confirm the reading of 'sem diagnóstico há mais de 90 dias' (AC-dm-34). The service lists a company with no completed, non-archived diagnosis only in withoutDiagnosis, not in overdue. A company with a diagnosis older than 90 days is listed in overdue. If the owner wants never-diagnosed companies counted by creation date in overdue, that is a change to buildConsultantView in homeService.ts.

Local Done-when passes. Verified by reading: the test file runs the real app (createApp with createTestDatabase) rather than a parallel fixture; the 7-day and 90-day lines are strict and move with the injected clock; risks are sorted by score descending in shared/domain/riskSignals.ts, so the first high risk is the highest; a single open draft per company is enforced by the repository transaction in server/repositories/diagnosisRepository.ts, so the consultant and owner draft lookups agree.

findings.summary: The browser check for AC-dm-33 (concluding or archiving a diagnosis changes the home indicators on the next open) could not run: no Playwright config and no tests/e2e folder exist in this worktree yet. Command that would run it: `pnpm test:e2e`. Not part of this unit's Done-when; the API half is covered by the 32 tests in tests/api/homeRoutes.test.ts, including 'follows the diagnoses'.

The browser check for AC-dm-34 (consultoria stage steps open filtered lists; stale-draft, overdue and high-risk lists link to the right companies) could not run: it needs the frontend lane and the Playwright setup, neither present in this worktree. The API half is covered by the consultoria tests in tests/api/homeRoutes.test.ts.

Interpretation to confirm: a company with no completed, non-archived diagnosis is listed only in withoutDiagnosis (buildConsultantView, around lines 319-320), not in overdue. AC-dm-34's wording 'sem diagnóstico há mais de 90 dias' could be read to include such companies. The implementer documented this choice; it is not a defect against the local Done-when.
findings.failure_scenario: A consultant with a company that has never completed a diagnosis, created 200 days ago, sees it in 'sem diagnóstico' but not in the 90-day overdue list if the owner expected the 90-day line to count from creation.

evidence.summary: Test Files 16 passed (16); Tests 713 passed (713). The literal '--' passed to vitest runs the whole suite, so the Done-when command passes but does not filter to the one file.
No diagnostics. Vitest does not type-check, so this is the type check of the server files in the unit.

evidence.command: ls -la (project root) for stray '=' file and test-results/
evidence.summary: No stray '=' file and no test-results/ directory in the project root. The implementer's accidental e2e run had left these; they were removed before this review.
